preferences.title: Accessibility
preferences.intro: These settings apply immediately and are remembered on this device.
preferences.motionHint: Reduced motion removes animated movement but keeps all content and highlights.
preferences.soundHint: Play a quiet tone for success and errors. A visible message is always shown too.

language.title: Language
language.intro: The layout switches direction with the language. Your entries and the open screen are kept.

prototypeTools.title: Prototype tools
prototypeTools.label: Show the design system lab in menus and search
prototypeTools.description: For people reviewing the prototype. Clients never see it in their workspace; its addresses keep working either way.

textSize.welcomeTitle: Choose the text size that’s comfortable for you
textSize.welcomeBody: Tap a size and the page changes straight away. You can change it later in settings.
textSize.changeLater: You can change this any time: account menu → Text size.
textSize.settingsHint: Applies straight away on every screen of this app, for you in this organisation.

hub.resetAllEffect: Text size, fonts, spacing, reading mode, theme, contrast, colours, motion, sound and guided-tour settings return to their defaults. Your language is kept, and you will not be asked to choose a text size again.
hub.resetDone: Everything is back to its default.
hub.saved: Saved for {{name}} at {{org}} in this browser (prototype). In the product, your settings are kept with your profile and follow you to every device you sign in on.
hub.savedDevice: Before you sign in, these settings belong to this device.
hub.languageKept: {{language}} is used whenever you sign in here.

fonts.title: Fonts
fonts.intro: Choose a typeface for each script. Figures and references stay easy to read either way.

system.label: Your device's font
system.description: The font your phone or computer already uses

readable.label: Atkinson Hyperlegible
readable.description: Designed for readers with low vision

nastaliq.label: Nastaliq
nastaliq.description: The traditional Urdu hand; lines get more room

density.title: Spacing
density.intro: How much room there is around buttons, lists and cards.
density.touchNote: On touch screens and phones, buttons keep their full size whichever you choose.

reading.title: Reading mode
reading.label: Simplified reading mode
reading.description: Hides decorative pictures, stops movement, flattens shadows, adds line spacing and underlines links. Nothing you need is removed.

theme.title: Theme
theme.intro: Light or dark backgrounds, or follow your device.
theme.deviceNow: Your device is using {{mode}} right now.

contrast.title: Contrast
contrast.intro: Stronger contrast makes text, borders and the keyboard focus easier to see.

system.label: Follow my device setting
system.description: Uses more contrast when your device asks for it

high.label: High contrast
high.description: Maximum contrast with strong outlines and underlined links. Replaces colour palettes.

palette.title: Colour palette
palette.intro: Colours for buttons, links and highlights. Text and status colours stay readable whichever you choose.
palette.paused: High contrast is on, so colour palettes and your organisation's colours are paused. Your choice comes back when you turn high contrast off.

organisation.label: {{org}} colours
organisation.none: Your organisation has not chosen colours, so Evergreen is used

system.label: Follow my device setting
system.description: Reduces movement when your device asks for it

reduce.label: Reduce motion
reduce.description: Turns off animation and movement; content stays

full.label: Allow motion
full.description: Shows all animation, even if your device asks for less

sound.title: Sound and vibration
sound.hapticsHint: A short vibration with success and error messages.
sound.hapticsUnavailable: This device cannot vibrate, so nothing changes here.

preview.title: Live preview
preview.body: Your November bill is ready. Pay by 10 November to stay up to date.

hub.intro: Make the app comfortable for you. Every change applies at once and is saved for you in this organisation.
